messages:
Lena Ortiz: quick QA catch from a docs pass: /v1/generate OpenAPI still shows `timeout` as a string and examples use a single `generation` object. Live service expects `timeout_ms` (integer) and returns `generations` (array). folks copying examples hit 400s.

Marek Kowalski: thanks for flagging. can you paste the failing curl?

Lena Ortiz: repro: `curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?timeout=5000\" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hi"}'` -> 400 invalid type for timeout. server accepts `timeout_ms=5000` or header `X-Timeout-Ms: 5000`.

Jun Park: confirmed on staging. we deliberately renamed the param to `timeout_ms` and removed lax coercion to avoid ambiguity. docs need: (1) OpenAPI param rename to `timeout_ms` integer with example 5000, (2) update curl/python/js/go/rust examples to use `timeout_ms` or header, (3) update response examples to `generations` array, (4) add short migration note and changelog entry.

Priya Rao: small SDK mapping notes to include: JS -> `timeoutMs` (camelCase), Python -> `timeout_ms` kwarg, Go -> `TimeoutMs` struct field, Rust -> `timeout_ms` snake_case. also add query + header examples.

Marek Kowalski: also add a one-line infra smoke test asserting `generations` in response body to catch regressions. ops prefers docs + migration note over a server shim. we should prepare support blurb for customers who hit 400s.

Lena Ortiz: suggested OpenAPI snippet to paste in PR:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: timeout_ms
    in: query
    description: Timeout in milliseconds. Alternative: set header `X-Timeout-Ms`.
    schema:
      type: integer
      format: int32
      example: 5000
```
And a short JSON response example for docs:
```json
{ "id": "req_001", "model": "rwd-13b", "generations": [ { "text": "hi", "tokens": ["hi"], "metadata": {} } ], "perf": { "latency_ms": 34 } }
```

Jun Park: please also add a one-line migration example showing old -> new request: `?timeout=5000` -> `?timeout_ms=5000` and header example `X-Timeout-Ms: 5000`. call out that old string `timeout` will 400.

Priya Rao: i'll review SDK snippet changes. Marek, can you coordinate the support message?

Marek Kowalski: yes, I'll draft a short reply template and pin it in the support repo.

Lena Ortiz: opening PR now to update openapi/specs/generate.yaml, docs/examples/generate.md, docs/sdks/* snippets, docs/migrations/2026-03-timeout-ms-and-generations.md, and docs/CHANGELOG.md. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/5207 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review). assigning @Priya Rao @Marek Kowalski.
